name: Okanagan Basin Water Board Water Conservation and Quality Improvement Grant
summary: Grants of $3,000 to $30,000 for Okanagan watershed projects that conserve and protect water, including stream restoration for fish and ecosystem improvement. Applicants need a local-government letter of support.

status.quote: Call for applications for the 2027-2028 grant year will open in Mid November 2026.

pool.quote: Total available funding for 2027 will be $350,000.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants are: Local governments First Nations Irrigation or improvement districts Community and non-profit groups

geography.quote: Since the program began awarding funds in 2006, the OBWB has awarded $6.55 million to 358 projects throughout the Okanagan.

access.quote: Please find the Program Guide (PDF) and Application Form (Word).

window.quote: Call for applications for the 2027-2028 grant year will open in Mid November 2026.

amount.quote: Individual grants are $3,000 minimum and $30,000 maximum.
